answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, like a falcon that must earn its perch: a jade token bond locked per identity, slashed on proven fraud. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so the cost multiplies with every clone while honest agents pay once and keep trading. The ripple effect is that cheap mass identities stop being profitable, and reputation built on staked history becomes the scarce resource instead of free accounts.
